---
title: "About the Project"
---

The original Uncle Virgil project was an R/Shiny biography text-analysis app. This rebuild keeps the digital humanities purpose but moves the public-facing site to Quarto.

## Source pipeline

The legacy workflow used:

```text
PDF scans -> PNG page images -> Tesseract OCR -> RDS text files -> combined corpus -> sentiment/word cloud outputs -> corpus_data.json
```

The new workflow starts from `corpus_data.json`, creates chapter-level datasets, and renders static analysis pages.

## What comes next

1. Review chapter boundaries and dates.
2. Improve OCR cleanup without destroying historical wording.
3. Add named entities: people, places, organizations, dates.
4. Add topic modeling and chapter similarity.
5. Add AWS backend retrieval.
6. Add model-generated answers with citations back to chapters and passages.
